title: Assessing the Mechanisms and Impact of a Novel Cannabinoid Product for Gynecologic Pain
languageNote: No explicit language requirement was found in the public registry listing. This is shown as "not stated" — it does not indicate whether any particular language is supported. A translated Visit Ready interface does NOT mean this study can serve participants in that language. Confirm available languages and interpreter support directly with the study team.

self_answer.explanationEn: You need to read and sign the consent form before taking part. You can confirm this yourself.
self_answer.explanationEs: Debe leer y firmar el formulario de consentimiento antes de participar. Usted mismo puede confirmarlo.

self_answer.explanationEn: This study enrolls people who were assigned female at birth. You can answer this yourself.
self_answer.explanationEs: Este estudio incluye a personas a las que se les asignó el sexo femenino al nacer. Usted puede responderlo.

self_answer.explanationEn: You must be 21 years of age or older. You can confirm this yourself.
self_answer.explanationEs: Debe tener 21 años o más. Usted mismo puede confirmarlo.

check_records.sourceText: * Liver function test (LFT) values \>3x the upper limit of normal (ULN) at the baseline visit
check_records.explanationEn: Liver function test (LFT) results more than 3 times the upper limit of normal at the baseline visit would exclude participation. These are lab values that may already be in your medical records — bring them and ask the study team.
check_records.explanationEs: Resultados de pruebas de función hepática (LFT) superiores a 3 veces el límite normal en la visita inicial excluirían la participación. Son valores de laboratorio que pueden estar ya en sus registros médicos; llévelos y pregunte al equipo del estudio.

ask_study_team.explanationEn: Participants need to be able to have menstrual cycles. Whether this applies to you can depend on your medical situation — check with the study team if you are unsure.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Las participantes deben poder tener ciclos menstruales. Si esto aplica a su caso puede depender de su situación médica; consulte con el equipo del estudio si tiene dudas.

ask_study_team.sourceText: * Endorses one of the following gynecologic pain conditions: endometriosis, adenomyosis, chronic pelvic inflammatory disease (PID)
ask_study_team.explanationEn: You need a diagnosis of endometriosis, adenomyosis, or chronic pelvic inflammatory disease (PID). A clinician confirms these diagnoses — bring your records and ask the study team.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Necesita un diagnóstico de endometriosis, adenomiosis o enfermedad inflamatoria pélvica (EIP) crónica. Un profesional confirma estos diagnósticos; lleve sus registros y pregunte al equipo del estudio.

ask_study_team.sourceText:
* Stable medication/psychotherapy regimens for at least 3 months prior to starting the study, including hormonal contraceptives

Additional inclusion criteria for those in the PK subgroup:
ask_study_team.explanationEn: Your medications and any therapy (including hormonal contraceptives) need to have been stable for at least 3 months before starting. The study team can confirm whether your situation qualifies.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Sus medicamentos y cualquier terapia (incluidos los anticonceptivos hormonales) deben haber estado estables durante al menos 3 meses antes de comenzar. El equipo del estudio puede confirmar si su situación cumple el requisito.

ask_study_team.sourceText: * Willingness to participate in the PK procedures (i.e., agree to an indwelling catheter with repeated blood collection)
ask_study_team.explanationEn: For one subgroup (the PK group) only, you would need to agree to an indwelling catheter with repeated blood draws. The study team explains what this involves.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Solo para un subgrupo (el grupo PK), tendría que aceptar un catéter permanente con extracciones de sangre repetidas. El equipo del estudio explica en qué consiste.

ask_study_team.sourceText: * Meets criteria for DSM-5 classification of current substance use disorder, psychotic disorder, bipolar disorder, or an eating disorder
ask_study_team.explanationEn: Certain current mental-health conditions (such as a substance use disorder, psychotic disorder, bipolar disorder, or eating disorder, as defined by DSM-5) would exclude participation. A clinician determines this — ask the study team.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Ciertas afecciones de salud mental actuales (como un trastorno por uso de sustancias, trastorno psicótico, trastorno bipolar o trastorno alimentario, según el DSM-5) excluirían la participación. Un profesional lo determina; pregunte al equipo del estudio.

ask_study_team.explanationEn: People who currently use cannabinoid products are not eligible. If you are unsure whether something you use counts, ask the study team.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Las personas que actualmente usan productos con cannabinoides no son elegibles. Si no está seguro de si algo que usa cuenta, pregunte al equipo del estudio.

ask_study_team.sourceText: * Positive urine pregnancy test, are trying to become pregnant, or are currently breastfeeding
ask_study_team.explanationEn: You cannot take part if you are pregnant, trying to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Pregnancy is confirmed by a test at the study.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: No puede participar si está embarazada, intentando quedar embarazada o amamantando. El embarazo se confirma con una prueba en el estudio.

ask_study_team.sourceText: * Comorbid neuropathic pain or cancer-related pain
ask_study_team.explanationEn: Having nerve-related (neuropathic) pain or cancer-related pain at the same time would exclude participation. The study team can clarify how this applies to you.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Tener dolor de origen nervioso (neuropático) o dolor relacionado con el cáncer al mismo tiempo excluiría la participación. El equipo del estudio puede aclarar cómo aplica a su caso.

ask_study_team.sourceText: * Disclosure of a genetic polymorphism affecting CYP2C9 function
ask_study_team.explanationEn: A known genetic variation affecting the CYP2C9 enzyme (which influences how the body processes certain substances) would exclude participation. This comes from genetic testing — ask the study team.
ask_study_team.explanationEs: Una variación genética conocida que afecta la enzima CYP2C9 (que influye en cómo el cuerpo procesa ciertas sustancias) excluiría la participación. Esto proviene de pruebas genéticas; pregunte al equipo del estudio.

cannot_assess.sourceText: * Presence of a serious or unstable medical illness, including liver/kidney disease, cardiovascular disease, neurological disorder, and conditions or medications that impact drug absorption or gastric emptying (e.g., GLP-1 agonists)
cannot_assess.explanationEn: Serious or unstable medical conditions (for example liver/kidney disease, heart disease, neurological disorders, or medications affecting how the body absorbs drugs, such as GLP-1 agonists) would exclude participation. This needs the study team's medical review.
cannot_assess.explanationEs: Afecciones médicas graves o inestables (por ejemplo, enfermedad hepática/renal, cardíaca, trastornos neurológicos o medicamentos que afectan la absorción de fármacos, como los agonistas de GLP-1) excluirían la participación. Esto requiere la revisión médica del equipo del estudio.

disclaimers: Visit Ready does not decide whether you qualify for this study. There is no eligibility score.
Do not get new medical tests just to use this tool. Bring records you already have.
A Spanish interface here does not mean the study can serve Spanish-speaking participants. Confirm with the study team.
Recruitment status and contacts come from the public registry and may be out of date — verify with the study team.
